verdict.rationale: incident.io documents its own postmortem features. These include AI-generated first drafts, inline review suggestions, section redrafting, and completion tracking through list views, a post-incident flow and policies. It also auto-generates an incident timeline, but the evidence never says drafts are built from that timeline, and templates and publication are not documented at all. Missing for 10: postmortem templates, explicit drafting from the timeline, a human review/approval step, publication/sharing of postmortems, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, postmortems follow a real workflow — templates, drafting from the timeline, review, and publication

citations.quote: Generate first drafts, get inline review suggestions, and redraft sections with AI.
Track post-mortem completion across your org with list views, the post-incident flow, and policies.
We generate a simple timeline based on key events, but you can always add your own narrative or events that happened in an external system.
